name: Nomura Streetwear Touch-Tag Graffiti Gloves
description:
Fingerless gloves with reservoirs built into each fingertip cap that dispense color-coded conductive ink through pressure-activated micro-nozzles. The wearer can tag surfaces with marks visible only under UV light or to AR-equipped observers. Each glove holds six hours of continuous use.

The preferred tool of GLMZ's digital graffiti artists, who layer invisible messages across the city's surfaces. The marks persist for weeks and can contain encoded data readable by the right AR software — turning walls into message boards that only the initiated can see.
functionality: Invisible UV/AR-visible tagging, encoded data marking, 6-hour reservoir capacity
what_it_says: You write on the city in a language that cameras can't read and most people can't see.
story_hooks: A building scheduled for demolition is found covered in Touch-Tag marks that, when decoded through AR, contain a detailed map of something hidden inside the walls.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek fingerless gloves with prominent padded fingertip caps that bulge slightly with internal reservoirs. Worn low on the wrist with an athletic, street-ready silhouette. The fingertip nozzles are barely visible—small chrome nodes catching light. Design suggests function over flash, but with deliberate style.
physical_description.fit: Snug compression fit through the palm and across the knuckles, fingerless design allows full dexterity. Wrist cuff sits loose and flexible, roughly 3 inches of coverage. Fingertip caps are form-fitted but allow slight articulation.
physical_description.primary_material: Treated synthetic leather on palm and back, moisture-wicking technical mesh on wrist. Fingertip caps are rigid polymer composite with micro-injection molding. Internal tubing is medical-grade synthetic with conductive polymer coating.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly tacky synthetic leather for grip. Fingertip caps have subtle ridged texture for ergonomic pressure points. Mesh wrist section is breathable and textured. Chrome nozzle nodes are cold and precise to the touch.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black primary with gunmetal gray accents on fingertip caps and wrist reinforcement bands. Small color-coded rings around each nozzle (red, blue, cyan, yellow, magenta, white) indicate ink cartridge colors. Subtle reflective piping along edges.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic friction-fit wrist cuff with hidden adjustment slots. No visible closures—designed for quick on/off. Fingertip caps are sealed pressure-lock modules, user-replaceable.
distinctive_features: Pressure-activated micro-nozzles in each fingertip cap
Conductive polymer tubing visible along knuckle ridge
Subtle Nomura logo embossed on wrist mesh
Haptic feedback nodes in palm—vibrate when ink depletes
Integrated thermal regulation to prevent ink crystallization
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional streetwear. Accessible to working-class creatives but requires legitimate purchase through approved retailers. Not black-market salvage, but also not corpo-tier luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street artist, digital graffiti activist, subversive communicator. Wearer is likely part of GLMZ's underground AR-culture scene—someone who leaves invisible messages for community members with the right implants or software. Signal of artistic rebellion with technical sophistication.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn-in but maintained. Fingertip caps show minor scuff marks and micro-cracks from repeated pressure use. Wrist mesh may have small snags. Ink residue stains on edges (visible only under UV light). Ink cartridges are frequently swapped and refilled. Overall appearance: functional, street-tested, but still operational and cared-for.
